message.content: {"action":"decrease_precision","reason":"The best SQNR/area tradeoff so far is the 14-bit LUT (72.84 dB, 1346 um^2); the 16-bit LUT improves SQNR to 82.12 dB but costs 1584 um^2, while the CORDIC alternative is both worse numerically (70.84 dB) and much larger (2837 um^2). Decreasing precision is the only legal action with unvisited neighbors and should explore a lower-area point near the efficient 14-bit design rather than pushing into higher-area/higher-precision variants."}
